business_summary: Almonty Industries mines and processes tungsten ore concentrate at the Sangdong mine in South Korea, which began feeding stockpiled run-of-mine ore through its newly commissioned processing plant in June 2026 and is expected to supply over 80% of global non-China tungsten production once at full capacity. FY2025 revenue was CAD 32.5M, up 12.8% from CAD 28.8M in FY2024, while the company posted a large net loss (CAD -161.9M) driven substantially by non-operating items well beyond its CAD -36.2M operating loss.

exposure_summary.narrative: ALM sits on the chain's single upstream feedstock link (tungsten-ore-and-scrap-feedstock, scored CROWDED), sourced to Almonty's own July 2026 press release on Sangdong's commissioning. It is one of only two placements on this link in the mapping (with Guardian Metal Resources), concentrating the non-China mine-supply story in essentially one still-ramping asset.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Almonty is a single-commodity tungsten miner and does not disclose a separate tungsten revenue percentage; substantially all revenue is tungsten concentrate sales.
